analysis: observed labor-denominator repair and heat-source readiness
claim_scope: Public source audit for the climate-health workday proxy. It repairs the exposed-worker denominator with observed WDI fields and verifies a public CCKP national tasmax route, but it does not estimate heat exposure, worker lost workdays, or causal health impacts.

owner_gated_or_unfinished_steps: The observed denominator repair now uses public WDI population, ages 0-14 share, and employment-to-population 15+ fields.
The CCKP national tasmax route is visible, but country means are not gridded worker exposure.
No WBGT, hours-worked, occupation schedule, subnational labor denominator, or observed lost-workday outcome is joined.
The PM2.5 cap-saturation finding remains a measurement caution, not a health-impact estimate.

indicator_records.indicator_name: Employment to population ratio, 15+, total (%) (modeled ILO estimate)

source_rows.source_name: World Bank WDI employment-to-population, population, and ages 0-14 indicators
source_rows.notes: 34 of 34 rankable DMCs have the three public WDI fields needed to derive employed 15+ persons before applying the outdoor share.

source_rows.source_name: World Bank CCKP CMIP6 national tasmax climatology
source_rows.status: source visible; not joined to workers or work hours
source_rows.notes: Baseline tasmax values were parsed for 34 rankable DMCs and future SSP2-4.5 tasmax values for 34; this is country-level source readiness, not worker heat exposure.

source_rows.source_name: Worker location x heat x work-hours exposure object
source_rows.notes: No gridded heat or WBGT, worker-location surface, sectoral work-hours schedule, or observed lost-workday outcome is joined.
